1. Ranking All 7 US Platforms From Lowest Fee to Highest Fee (2026)

1) Shopify Basic (Shopify Payments): 2.9% + $0.30 (~3.6% on a $40 sale, plus $39/mo fixed). 2) TikTok Shop US (organic): 6.0% flat referral. 3) Etsy US (organic): 6.5% + 3.0% + $0.45 (~10.6% effective; 22.6%+ with Offsite Ads).

4) Mercari US: 10.0% flat seller fee. 5) Whatnot Live: 8% commission + 2.9% + $0.30 on item+ship+tax (~12.1%+ effective). 6) eBay US (no store): 13.6% on item+ship+tax + $0.40 (~15.5%+ effective). 7) Poshmark US: 20.0% flat commission ($2.95 under $15).

2. The Smart Cross-Listing Playbook for Resellers & Brands
